Subtitle text 'Provisional: fitted to past weather on a screening run. G-all+D1 (G-all+D1+steps for the steps panel), final cut 2025-07-01. All vertical axes are points of effective capacity unless labelled; a positive term raises net power. Hour bands: night, morning, midday, evening (purple, orange, sky, blue). Capacity has no interval: the fit gives a point estimate.'
text.tspan: Provisional: fitted to past weather on a screening run. G-all+D1 (G-all+D1+steps for the steps
panel), final cut 2025-07-01. All vertical axes are points of effective capacity unless
labelled; a positive term raises net power. Hour bands: night, morning, midday, evening
(purple, orange, sky, blue). Capacity has no interval: the fit gives a point estimate.
